messages:
alex.prather: Hey team — small spike of 502s hitting hosted-api from edge over the last 20m. Pattern: short streaming requests (~3–10s) get an upstream reset from Envoy. Seeing this across a handful of tenants but reproducible under load for one customer. trace ids below. Anyone on watch?

maria.wang: I pulled traces — env: envoy v1.26.0, upstream errors show ERR_STREAM_RESET and PROTO_ERR. Tenant=acme-inc looks noisy. Envoy metrics show high h2 stream concurrency on a few nodes. Could be h2 multiplexing + auth service slowdowns. :eyes:

jon.saito: Can you paste a quick curl repro and one of the envoy/edge stats dumps? Also need auth-service logs for the same window. @sre-bot can you fetch stats for edge-03/edge-04?

sre-bot: stats pulled for edge-03 (snippet):
```
cluster.redwood_upstream.upstream_cx_overflow: 12
cluster.redwood_upstream.cluster_upstream_rq_5xx: 142
cluster.redwood_upstream.upstream_cx_proto_err: 87
h2.streams_open: 1023
h2.max_concurrent_streams_configured: 1000
connection_pool.pending_streams: 214
```
Looks like edge-03 is hitting configured max_concurrent_streams and queuing streams.

samira.khan: Repro steps I used: looped 200 concurrent http2 requests against /v1/generate with small prompt payloads:
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate & done; wait
```
Under steady load ~3% of requests returned 502 within 30s of starting. I attached a sample request/response with trace id abc123.

emma.devex: FYI I rolled a quick mitigation: reduced keepalive_timeout and lowered thread pool on edge-03 for 15m to shed queued streams. Preliminary effect: 502 rate dropped ~50% for that node. This is a short-term mitigation; still seeing tail errors.

kyle.infra: Root cause hypothesis: HTTP/2 connection-level stream saturation + an auth upstream occasionally blocking streams (auth heartbeat delays). Options: 1) enforce lower per-connection max_concurrent_streams (e.g., 250) 2) add per-tenant circuit-breaker + backpressure to auth pool 3) increase auth-service connection pool size. Plan: set per-connection streams on edge-03..06 and monitor for 30m, then roll cluster-wide if stable. Target 01:00 UTC for rolling restarts.

alex.prather: Sounds good. Capture trace ids for postmortem: abc123, def456, ghi789. Please tag INF-4722 in the ticket and include the reproduction steps and envoy stat snapshot. Once we confirm infra change reduces rate we can make it config change. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Created ticket INF-4722 with attachments (envoy-stats-edge-03.log, sample-traces.json). Notifying oncall.

jon.saito: Quick ask — can we also enable a short-lived response queue metric (queued_streams_per_conn) so we can alert before resets? That would help avoid next burst.

emma.devex: Will add a dashboard card and a low-threshold alert for queued_streams_per_conn. Adding runbook steps to the ticket.

alex.prather: Thanks everyone. We'll follow up after the rollout and include numbers in the incident note.
